items.title: Framework for monitoring utilisation of issue proceeds under review: Sebi
items.description: Sebi chairman said transparency is not merely about the volume of information disclosed by a company but about whether the information helps investors understand what matters

items.title: Sebi proposes tighter curbs on promotional claims by online bond platforms
items.description: The proposed code would operate alongside a common advertisement code applicable to specified Sebi-regulated entities

items.title: Sebi proposes channel partners to expand retail access to bonds in India
items.description: The proposal aims to improve access to fixed-income products in Tier-II, Tier-III cities and rural areas, according to a consultation paper issued by Sebi on Friday
